description: This PHP source file handles API requests related to Easy Connect feature, including token generation, validation, and request processing for device configurations. It references external utility includes and processes HTTP requests based on request method and headers, managing authentication tokens and configuration settings.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Generates or retrieves an encryption key stored in specific files. Creates new key if necessary and manages associated files.

methods.name: genToken
methods.description: Generates a secure token using AES encryption and returns it encoded, including error handling.

methods.name: validateToken
methods.description: Validates an input token by decrypting and checking its expiration time.

methods.name: processPostRequest
methods.description: Processes incoming POST requests to configure a WiFi device, including parsing DPP URIs and updating configuration parameters.

methods.name: authenticateCaller
methods.description: Performs authentication based on headers, generating or validating tokens as needed, involving security checks.
